title: The multi-height distribution implies the Batyrev-Manin principle
summary: We explain how to deduce from the multi-height analysis of rational points on a toric stack (respectively on a toric variety) the asymptotic study of the number of rational points of bounded orbifold anticanonical height (respectively bounded anticanonical height), using a general version of the hyperbola method developed by Marta Pieropan and Damaris Schindler.
